LanguageData.DeathrestAccelerator.description: A blood pump used to hasten recovery from vitamin deficiency.
LanguageData.DeathrestAccelerator.label: vitamin pump
LanguageData.DeathrestCapacitySerum.description: A serum designed to increase the body's ability to withstand Wendigo sickness.
LanguageData.DeathrestCapacitySerum.label: wendigo capacity serum
LanguageData.DeathrestCasket.description: A containment casket for those suffering from cannibal's vitamin deficiency syndrome known as "The Shakes".
LanguageData.DeathrestCasket.label: the box
LanguageData.GlucosoidPump.description: A blood pump used to create muscle mineral reserves.
LanguageData.GlucosoidPump.label: mineral pump
LanguageData.HemogenAmplifier.description: A blood pump used to increase hemogen absorption.
LanguageData.HemogenAmplifier.label: protein pump
LanguageData.Hemopump.description: A blood pump used to help with bloodflow and relax muscles.
LanguageData.Hemopump.label: blood pump
LanguageData.PsychofluidPump.description: A blood pump for stabilizing mental symptoms, relaxing their mind and helping them to focus.
LanguageData.PsychofluidPump.label: chem pump
LanguageData.WestTek_FEVCulture.description: A stabilized culture kept alive for higher-order Forced Evolutionary Virus work. Guaranteed transformation results when used in procedures. A colonist can analyze this culture to unlock FEV-3 research.
LanguageData.WestTek_FEVProbe.description: A crude pre-refinement sample of Forced Evolutionary Virus growth medium. It is unstable and difficult to handle safely. A colonist can analyze this probe to unlock FEV-1 research.
LanguageData.WestTek_FEVSample.description: A concentrated viral sample suitable for controlled testing. More stable than raw probe material. A colonist can analyze this sample to unlock FEV-2 research.
